name: gy-income-tax
description: Guyana personal income tax for the 2026 year of income (year of assessment 2027) under the Income Tax Act, Cap. 81:01, as amended by the Fiscal Enactments (Amendment) Act 2026 (Act No. 3 of 2026). Covers residents and non-residents, employees under PAYE and the self-employed, the 2026 personal allowance of G$1,680,000 or one third of total income (whichever is greater), the 25% rate on chargeable income up to G$3,360,000 and 35% above it, the child, second-job and overtime deductions, employee NIS contributions, medical and life insurance premiums, mortgage interest relief, the 2% minimum tax on self-employed service providers above G$10 million turnover, quarterly advance tax, the 30 April 2027 return and the late filing and late payment penalties. Trigger on: Guyana income tax 2026, GRA income tax return, G0004, personal allowance Guyana, PAYE Guyana, 7B slip, Guyana self-employed tax, advance tax Guyana. Out of scope: companies in gy-corporate-income-tax, NIS in gy-payroll-social, V
